solution: Easy to use and integrate SDK that does the heavy lifting by enabling developers to add privacy, security and traceability in Cardano apps.

title: Indie Cardano Node
problem: We need to demonstrate that the Cardano community is capable of sustaining the development and implementation of the Cardano protocol.
solution: Plan and start the implementation of an independent implementation of the Cardano Protocol.

title: Cardano Adoption in D.R. of Congo
problem: Bitcoin scams have led the government to take a negative stance on crypto currencies that result in bans and discourage blockchain adoption.
solution: Create a local Blockchain Hub for Solution Design, for both developer and policy-maker onboarding.

title: New Compensation Plan
problem:
Currently only idea creators (Proposers) and some Referrers are being rewarded.
We need to expand compensation to more participants.
solution: Create a new compensation plan that reaches out to more participants. Having more people collaborate on an idea and be rewarded accordingly.

title: DeSci - Decentralised Science
problem: Academic publication is highly centralised where the value created by authors and peer-reviews is transferred to gate-keeper publishers.
solution: Tokenisation of publications with smart contracts in the peer-review process and continued community engagement of the publication.

title: Tokenize West Africa projects
problem: Interest rates in West Africa are commonly above 20% a year, 87% of innovative projects in Africa do not have access to any funding.
solution:
Create a tokenization ecosystem for financing innovative projects in West Africa.
help technically, structure, and tokezine seed projects.

title: Infographics - Series 1
problem: Information about Project Catalyst is difficult to digest for many.
solution: Create a series of info graphics that visually describe Project Catalyst.

title: Crowdfunding Platform
problem: Catalyst offers limited funding. Winning does't guarantee successful implementation of a project. Proposers need follow-on funding.
solution: Innovatio can be a commercial complement of Catalyst organized to help 100s & 1000s of proposal expecting funding by the Cardano treasury.

title: Indigenous Art Authenticity
problem: COVID pandemic pushed indigenous artists to sell online. Ensuring authenticity of indigenous goods sold online is crucial to their survival.
solution: Convert IndigeneArts.com to be a niche NFT marketplace featuring indigenous art, certified by digital certificates of authenticity.

title: Telecom infrastructure tokenization
problem: Build a team to help the tokenization of a several open RAN municipal projects.
solution: Enabling the people and municipalities to own the telecommunications network infrastructure where operators offer their service

title: Delegation Tracker
problem: Onboarding barrier for ADA delegators is large, existing solutions cause centralization of stake.
solution: Improve the customer experience of onboarding and staking and provide a solution that will allow for better distribution of stake.

title: Afri-pay
problem: Africans often do not use bank accounts and even when they do they have the control they should when transferring money from A to B.
solution: Design of a money transfer platform using Blockchain technology, allowing users to transfer money from one account to another without limit.

title: Cardano Katas
problem: How to accelerate adoption and development of dApps on Cardano given Haskell is not a mainstream programming language?
solution: Prepare a set of code katas for developers to try out one at a time and get trained to code and integrate dApps for real life use cases.

title: Music Database MIDI blockchain
problem: The way in wich we can relation with music actually is very limited.
solution: Create an application where we can share and search for music with freedom something like musescore.com + Synthesia but in blockchain

title: Training program NOA-NEA Argentina.
problem: In Argentina, the ignorance of the Cardano ecosystem is complete with more than 2 million potential users of the network.
solution: Implement a training program on the use of Cardano, presenting use cases in the Spanish language to multiplying referents.

title: Multiplayer Game using Cardano
problem: Making Cardano mainstream. Training young developers.
solution: In my multiplayer online game, I want to implement Cardano for asset management, contracts and payments (internal and external).

title: Idea to Team Connection Support
problem: Some folks with good ideas and business acumen cant code; some folks who can code don't have the business acumen
solution: Allow proposal submitters to identify what they need to push their idea or team to the next level.

title: Haskell SDK for Blockfrost API
problem: Haskell developers are missing tools to fully enjoy Blockfrost.io, a service that provides free and public Cardano API to developers.
solution: We want to build an open-source SDK (Software Development Kit - a set of tools, libraries and documentation) for Haskell developers.

title: Direct funding: Medusa AdaWallet
problem: Lack of time to follow roadmap in a good temp because of "enthusiast project" status. But there are a lot of requests from community.
solution: Boost development process of the project by providing an ability to leave the main jobs and focus on the Cardano Ecosystem.

title: Synthesis - Hybrid Crowdfunding
problem: Simple crowdfunding, sales and defi in a single, turnkey platform for individuals, communities, business and enterprises.
solution: Random number generator raffles providing crowdfunding solutions for : auctions, lotteries, defi, asset sales and financial services.

title: Open Source Governance UI
problem: Users are overwhelmed by distributed decision making, and developers do not have the funding to complete the network upgrades.
solution: CommonWealth provides blockchain networks a reliable and time-tested UX/UI to empower their users and devs to make decisions quickly.

title: The Cardano Global Treasure Hunt
problem: More people need to discover Cardano. Create a desire for them to engage in a fun way by organising a global event with dapps to support it.
solution: Attract new users to the Cardano ecosystem by harnessing the ingenuity of its global community to organise a unique, fun & rewarding event.

title: Tokenized ADA for Yield Farming
problem: Huge amounts are locked up in DeFi yield farms on Eth and BSC. They don't want to move to Cardano yet because of lesser yield opportunities.
solution: A token with 1:1 convertibility with ADA, allowing holders to keep staking their underlying ADA while also yield farming using the tokens.

title: TipADA - Decentralized $ADA Tipping
problem: There is a great demand for showing appreciation of content and ideas by tipping $ADA to a creator. Currently no solution is available.
solution: A possible solution is to create a browser extension for all major platform to facilitate tipping $ADA tokens on multiple social platforms.

title: +Rideshare-CO2 = Ada
problem: Our planet's ecosystem is being destroyed by high carbon emissions, worsened by the fact that too many solo drivers are on the road.
solution: Incentivize ride-sharing by tokenizing and issuing carbon "credits" in ADA as a reward to users for CO2 emissions saved on shared trips.

title: CardanoArcade
problem: The Cardano (ADA) ecosystem needs viable entertainment environment where users can use their ADA in a trusted space/evironment.
solution: Create a trustless, permission-less, and high-performance e-gaming platform where users can play games like poker, slot machines, and more.

title: Help University/hacker association
problem: An incentive to use Cardano has to be created for groups that are creating and experimenting with new technologies.
solution: Provide useful real case examples and hints to use Cardano. Those hints can be used for hackathons and university groups/projects.

title: Charity Casino
problem: People want to make change but don't have the skills, finances or time to do it. How can we help hubs flourish?
solution:
Every 5 days a winning donator will be picked.
Winner receives:

1% of epochs staking rewards
4% rewards to hub/charity of his choice

title: Decentralized Football Betting Pool
problem: Football betting pools face limitations due to lack of transparency, inconvenient buy-ins/payouts, and require trust in a centralized party.
solution: I will create a dapp that will allow casual fans to easily create and participate in transparent football betting pools of various prices.

title: Golang SDK for Blockfrost API
problem: Go language developers are missing tools to fully enjoy Blockfrost.io, a service that provides free and public Cardano API to developers.
solution: We want to build an open-source SDK (Software Development Kit - a set of tools, libraries and documentation) for Go developers.

title: +WADA Outreach=Smart Catalyst Users
problem: WADA's outreach is currently limited by their web app capacity. They need their own solid integrated management system to optimize outreach.
solution: Build WADA a solid, scalable, distributed, proof of concept system/ Dapp from the ground up using Servant Server, Haskell, and Elm.

title: + Dev incentives in Cameroon
problem: Need welcoming space for developers to come together and brainstorm solutions (on a community level) built on Distributed Ledger Technology.
solution: Offer unique gateway into the world of DLT, incentivizing Hub attendance and participation by providing above and beyond community support.

title: tokenize agricultural products
problem: Colombian farmers earn very little. people die of hunger in Colombia. investors are currently unable to trade agricultural digital assets
solution: Farmers receive token rewards for their work. people will have food. enable investors and individuals to trade agricultural digital assets

title: OctoWars - a game platform
problem: Cardano doesn't provide a simple and elegant way to build trading cards and turn based strategies.
solution: Build a PoC game and continue development until it's deployed to production. Based on that experience build a game platform.

title: Large Example Projects for Devs
problem: How can we provide a paved path for developers to understand all the technologies that need to come together to build a decent sized dapp?
solution: Build a reference dapp (for example, a Uniswap v1 clone) from front to back, for people to study, that is well documented and open source.

title: Make donations transparent
problem: Companies use donating percentages of their profits as marketing tool. Yet, this is hard and time-consuming to verify for customers.
solution: A smart-contract to automatically forward x% received at an address to charity organizations. Add explorer function for simple verification.

title: Behavioural based governance
problem: Our governance systems are super complex and are often underdesigned, most solutions solve problems that were not fully understood
solution: Design a system by understanding the problem deeply, iterating on that , and going from there.

title: Proof-of-Free-Will ADA HW wallet
problem: Current solutions for protecting digital assets are missing the tight bond to real physical identity of a person beyond simple PIN/Password.
solution: ADA first HW wallet capable of protecting keys by static & behavioral biometrics to enable secure transactions without passwords.

title: Online Makerspace
problem: There are no platform that puts the Maker in the front seat around their ideas, or what a product have been used for after it is sold.
solution: We are building an online rapid prototyping platform that will incentivize the Makers and provide a red thread back to the industry.

title: Adaption and integration of Cardano
problem: Implementing Cardano in society requires also many non ICT technical aspects: legal, political, stakeholders postions, etc
solution: By use of an interdisciplinary scientific approach and a powerful network of strategist, political scientists.

title: Decentralized Event-Risk Contracts
problem: Insurance is one of the oldest financial products. Hedging against risk is fundamental to life and business, yet it is a overly complicated.
solution: Make an insurance marketplace where insurers and policyholders enter into contracts, initially based on on-chain data with Oracles ASAP.

title: Cardano LCC - Community Outreach DK
problem: Blockchain & cryptocurrencies generates a rampant increase in public interest, but there is no formal or educational institutions available
solution: A LCC would alleviate the rampant increase in demand for an educational institution, and be first movers in an untapped region

problem: Elixir developers are missing tools to fully enjoy Blockfrost.io, a service that provides free and public Cardano API to developers.
solution: We want to build an open-source SDK (Software Development Kit - a set of tools, libraries and documentation) for Elixir developers.

problem: PoolPeek.com is built by small pool owners for small pool delegators. Small stake pools need more ways for delegators to find their pools.
solution: offer additional views where delegators can see small pools in interesting ways, add a chatbot, create a new cardano token viewer website.

title: Universal news subscription
problem: News organisations rely heavily on ads that rewards clicks which result in poor quality content.
solution: Introduce a DApp with associated token. Users purchase token and gets ad-free access to participating news sites. DApp pay sites accordingly

title: Guides to project Catalyst success
problem: Catalyst is a confusing place when you are new to it. New users don't have a really concise guide to doing well on Project Catalyst
solution: Create concise guides to being successful on project Catalyst for all (enthusiasts, developers, entrepreneurs, community advisors, etc)

problem: There is currently no platform or framework for the Cardano Community to discuss, prioritize and solve Latin American issues in Spanish.
solution: ALDEA is a DAO that enables people to communicate, self-govern, produce and trade as a decentralized and autonomous Community.

title: Blockchain in Education
problem: Generally, significant higher education blockchain use cases are, for instance, record-keeping and performance optimization.
solution: This new educational platform uses blockchain smart contracts to automate administrative tasks, protect and secure faculty and students.

title: imToken wallet integration
problem: Cardano needs more mobile wallets in the Asian market.
solution: imToken is a mobile wallet that can support Cardano, with a huge user base in the Asian markets, with focus in China.

problem: No streamlined framework to onboard talented West Africans making contact through Cardano websites/social media/groups into Project Catalyst
solution: Implement a diversified membership scheme to attract and engage W/Africans to contribute to Project Catalyst goals

title: Dapps of financial analysis on DEFI
problem: the future is DEFI and investors need specialized financial analysis before investing.
solution: we will generate financial reports on DEFI to whoever requests it, by a group of securities and crypto professionals

title: Catalyst Legal Fund
problem: If we are doing our job, we'll be pushing new boundaries and proposers need a legal point of contact.
solution: The CF takes the proposal amount and sets up legal fund for proposers and cohorts.

title: Cardano Center in Europe
problem: There is no place in Europe where developers, entrepreneurs and other community members can meet to learn and work on Cardano projects.
solution: We want to develop a Cardano Center with coworking space and activities (meetups, demos, brainstorms, workshops and training) in Amsterdam.

title: ADA MyProject Freelance
problem: High demand for blockchain-related projects
solution: Using a platform to unify the needs to carry out technology projects and hire freelancers to develop the projects

title: Scale Up&Go
problem: Decentralise and scale up worker owned gig platform up&go to offer easy adoption in other cities, teams, languages, services and currencies.
solution: Rebuild an easily adoptable upandgo.coop platform as a Dapp to enable gig workers to take advantage of DeFin, creating fair employment.

title: Create Social Network in Catalyst
problem: Create a social network so participants can like and work with each other and shares ideas and collaborate.
solution: Allowing people to share and work on ideas within catalyst and allow for the development of the social network.

title: These Walled Gardens - DevThemePark
problem: We live/operate in physical/digital silos that limit the flow in and out of social groups and devs need a fast track lane to teams/tools.
solution: Create a contextual microcosmic space to onboard devs and show the way to the playground. The Garden the self-identification center to zoo.

problem: Building a brand reaching 1 billion people will require bold strategy and precise execution when Bitcoin is so far ahead in mindshare
solution: Execute a viral media campaign demonstrating the power of Cardano to innovators and investors to spur action to learn more about Cardano

Zero config, instant Cardano node access for free.

title: Developer Library
problem: Developers have limited time to learn. Why not create a library of learning resources where each developer has a learning plan and a coach.
solution: Create a one stop shopping solution. A library where each developer can be coached on a learning plan by a qualified instructor. Teamwork!

title: Peer-to-peer Science
problem: Universities are oversized, inefficient middlemen. The direct transfer of funds from funders to scientists can be enabled by smart contracts
solution: A trust-less, smart contract system which allows funders to entrust their funds directly with scientists without University middlemen.

The germans are very sceptic on the entire cryptospace.

We create a website and host events that makes Cardanos vision visible for all germans.
-> Educate about Catalyst and get students on board.

problem: $300B surveillance capitalism market broke the customer relationship. People should control and benefit from the use of their personal data
solution: Dapp and permission-based customer platform, using personal data-licensing smart contracts, which pays people for their attention.

Staking ADA should not be the only way to earn ADA.

Increase content creators' monetization options: subscription payments in ADA.
Access content for short period of time or selected articles

solution: A Mobile App to educate on Project Catalyst, manage tasks for roles being worked on. Members will be rewarded with Catalyst tokens.

problem:
Current marketplaces are associated with the trade of illegal items
Hard to know history of sellers and buyers
Complicated to prove payment
solution:
Incentive the community to filter out illegal trades
Sellers and buyers' history stored on the blockchain
Ability to prove payment occured

problem: The upcoming changes in the Cardano will bring a lot of new features, support for which is not implemented in existing blockchain explorers
solution: Our platform will implement support for native tokens, smart contracts, and all other new features in the Cardano blockchain

problem: There isn't a clear strategy for getting up to speed as a developer new to Cardano
solution:
Group development resources by their audience under single source
Provide consistent information across documentation

problem: Creating new Cardano education and learning centres and labs is a big challenge which involves many aspects like location and equipments
solution: We can speed up the learning and adoption of Cardano by using existing universities labs, equipments and networks.

title: Decentralization Aids: Geo & Infra
problem: Cardano has an elegant design behind it, but delegators and stake pool operators need access to information to capture the potential of it.
solution: Web app which displays a pools relay location, stake and infrastructure provider, with the intent of spreading Cardano far and wide.

title: Gauntlets of Catalyst Courts
problem: Project Catalyst wants to attract the best/brightest outside entrepreneurs/firms and submit proposals in F5/F6.
solution: Post this Challenge on LinkedIN/Social Media and ask for comments, invite people to ideascale to create profiles and review proposals.

title: Content Creator Fanbase DEFI DAPP
problem: Content creators do not have tools to identify their "Most Valuable FANS" and do not have a way to reward fans with crypto or monetize fans
solution: Decentralized finance to let users pay for subscription with their interest automatically. Rank fans by sub and #of people they bring to you

title: Catalystwinners.com
problem: It is currently not easy to find which projects have won on each Fund. That could eventually undermine the transparency of Catalyst.
solution: A website showing the winning projects of each Fund and Campaign. Making Catalyst more transparent. This would encourage more participation.

problem: What are we making for dinner tonight?

problem: It is difficult for developers to get excited about Cardano if they cannot monetize their Cardano development skills (Plutus, Marlowe, Glow)

solution: Assess feasibility and deploy Ekofolio's native EKO and FOLIO tokens on Cardano, adding a sustainable Stablecoin use-case to the project.

title: University/College Outreach
problem: Solicit the youngest and brightest from around the globe to contribute to the network. Raising awareness with student organizations.
solution: Reach student associations and faculties to raise awareness. Social media blitz combined with newsletters and outreach activities to engage.

title: Family/Groups join planning dAPP

problem: It can be hard to find reliable predictions on the prices of assets, outcome of events, and other things people are interested in knowing.

title: DAO for creating governance tools
problem:
Voting is prone to errors and expensive

solution:
Creating Governance tools to collaboratively manage ideas and tasks
Dapps connect through Cardano for built-in security and transparency

title: Cardano spanish training programs
problem: There are no educational resources for spanish speakers who want to develop and grow their Cardano local community.
solution: Create an introductory Cardano spanish training program to understand its basics, and also a website to incentivize community engagement

title: Al-Baari. The Creator.
problem: Blockchain and multiple applications of Cardano, and this new era of technology, are foreign for the majority of the globe.

solution: IdeaScale is a good platform for starting up a fund, but funded proposals should live in a Cardano Foundation space.

solution: Incentivising interaction among people of different backgrounds (the greater the difference, the bigger the reward) brings about innovations

solution: We want to build an open-source SDK (Software Development Kit - a set of tools, libraries and documentation) for .NET developers.

problem: Cardano NEEDS a cutting edge layer 2 data solution that will handle large volumes of, and high rates of, irregular and complex data.
solution: A Decentralized AI System as a not-for-profit that will serve the community and charity.

solution: Physical change machine where a customer can deposit fiat and get a QR code ticket in return. Money is staked as ADA.

solution: A globally unified sustainable transport system thanks to a payment system with a common token which allows you to always use it

title: "They desire a better country."
problem: Proposers feel left out once their ideas have been rejected, while others further in the Catalyst funnel receive rewards for participating.
solution: Borrowing from traditional heraldry, I propose CF/IOHK issue individual NFT digital assets based on the Canadian Order of Merit system.

title: Gimbalabs Building Network Capacity
problem: To build something truly new, developers need tools, a learning community, and holistic support in elucidating ideas and fostering teams.
solution: Support experienced developers who are new to blockchain by building tools, creating educational resources, and cultivating project teams.

title: PlayerMint: Token System for Gamers
problem: Currently there is no way for the gaming masses to monetize their gameplay performance without serious time investment or monetary risk.
solution: PlayerMint will be a free-to-play platform that rewards gamers with fungible and non-fungible tokens based on their gameplay performance.

title: Working Groups
problem: We need to assemble talent in groups to then assign workflow and create synergies and efficiencies.
solution: Create professional talent pools that can assist projects with required tasks and the pool can share in the rewards.

title: Development Journey Documentation
problem: Current Plutus documentation is not very user-friendly, lacking real case examples, does not display a journey to Cardano dev eco-system
solution: Create more user-friendly website, add interesting use cases, accept small community project samples from various fields, community Q/A

title: Sustainable ADA
problem: Sustainable ADA will expand outreach and education for explaining use cases/examples of how Cardano can help create a sustainable world.
solution: Connecting Cardano to our current SDGs; how it can help create an equal and sustainable world. Creating educational content for all ages!

title: API for decentralized application
problem: The need to have rapid development tools already tested is observed
solution: in order to shorten development times and achieve effective implementation with APIs developed for that purpose.

title: L10N - localisation
problem: community + communication should start in the low cost high value - online - (through the best medium - video) then offline.
solution: utilise video (L10N program on caaast.live) to solve the high level communication, collaboration and compensation.

title: Rust SDK for Blockfrost API
problem: Rust developers are missing tools to fully enjoy Blockfrost.io, a service that provides free and public Cardano API to developers.
solution: We want to build an open-source SDK (Software Development Kit - a set of tools, libraries and documentation) for Rust developers.

title: Wrapped Ether - The WETHER token 🌧
problem: Wrapping Ethereum tokens will add liquidity to the Cardano ecosystem and allow Ethereum users to enjoy scalable Cardano dApps.
solution: The WETHER station allows users to deposit Ether and mint a wrapped Ether token with 1:1 correspondence, as well as withdraw WETHER to ETHER
